pricing.freeTierCaps: Unlimited transcription and AI summaries; 400 storage minutes per team; 20 one-time AI credits shared by the team.
pricing.billingTerms: monthly + annual; Enterprise is annual only
pricing.hiddenCosts: Included AI credits are one-time and shared across the entire team. When a paid team runs out, Fireflies automatically starts the lowest $5/50-credit monthly add-on unless disabled; purchased credits expire at each billing cycle.

verdictSummary: The summarizer is easy; the meeting bot, calendar routing, integrations, team search, and admin layer make it more than a one-prompt clone.
coreLoopDIY: Create a recorder/bot, capture call audio, transcribe, generate summaries/action items, store transcripts, and add keyword search.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because the bot reliably appears, captures, files, and shares notes across the whole team.

priorArt.name: whisper.cpp
priorArt.desc: Provides the commodity transcription layer; the SaaS moat is the meeting/integration layer

alternatives.name: Fathom
alternatives.desc: Unlimited recording, transcription, basic summaries, clips and search for one person; the revenue-team machinery remains paid.

facts.install: Hosted signup, connect Google or Outlook Calendar, and install or authorize Fathom's meeting capture app or bot
facts.engines: Fathom's proprietary AI plus third-party subprocessors including Anthropic, OpenAI and Google; individual model names are not disclosed
facts.dataFormat: Meeting audio/video, transcripts, notes and calendar/attendee metadata in Fathom's US-hosted cloud; recordings remain until deleted on free plans and can be downloaded or exported
facts.gapVsPaid: The free plan is individual-first and lacks Fireflies' richer team analytics, CRM workflow automation and broad cross-meeting collaboration.
facts.setupBlocker: Authorizing calendar, microphone or screen capture and the visible meeting bot or beta bot-free recorder

alternatives.name: OpenWhispr
alternatives.desc: One installer records meetings without a bot, labels speakers, summarizes them and keeps the archive searchable.

facts.install: Install the signed macOS DMG, Windows EXE or Linux package, grant audio/accessibility permissions and choose local, cloud or BYOK processing
facts.engines: Local Whisper via whisper.cpp; NVIDIA Parakeet and Nemotron via sherpa-onnx; local LLMs via llama.cpp; BYOK OpenAI, Groq, xAI, Mistral, Tinfoil, OpenRouter, Corti, Anthropic/Google and OpenWhispr Cloud
facts.dataFormat: Notes and history in local SQLite with recordings/model caches in app directories; optional sync uses OpenWhispr Cloud/Neon PostgreSQL, while cloud or BYOK audio goes to the selected provider
facts.gapVsPaid: It lacks Fireflies' mature managed bot and team analytics, while reliable capture depends on desktop audio permissions and routing.
facts.setupBlocker: Meeting capture needs OS audio permissions and a model download or cloud/API choice; macOS also needs Accessibility and Screen Recording/System Audio permission

alternatives.name: Speakr
alternatives.desc: A polished self-hosted call archive with transcription, summaries, search and chat; zero subscription, nonzero server.

facts.install: Download the example Docker Compose and .env, add transcription/text-model credentials or endpoints, set the admin account and run docker compose up -d
facts.engines: ASR via self-hosted WhisperX, OpenAI transcription, Mistral Voxtral, AssemblyAI, VibeVoice or custom endpoints; LLMs via any OpenAI-compatible endpoint including OpenRouter, OpenAI, Gemini, LocalAI or Ollama
facts.dataFormat: SQLite in the mounted instance directory, audio in mounted uploads or S3-compatible storage, and optional auto-exports such as Markdown and SRT files
facts.gapVsPaid: It has no managed calendar bot or automatic conferencing integrations; capture, uptime and every external integration are yours to operate.
facts.setupBlocker: Docker is mandatory for the easy path, and the operator must supply API keys or deploy a separate GPU ASR container plus reverse proxy/TLS

notes: Useful contrast with Granola: same AI primitive, harder product surface.
prompt:
Build me a searchable call transcript archive to replace Fireflies.ai. Requirements:

- A Node pipeline plus a local web app (Express + better-sqlite3, localhost).
- Ingest: watch ~/Recordings/ with chokidar, or `calls add <file>`. Transcribe
  locally with whisper.cpp, or Deepgram/OpenAI Whisper if a key is in .env.
- Summarize each call with an LLM (key in .env): overview, action items with
  owners, questions asked, next steps. Store summary and full transcript in
  SQLite.
- Search page: FTS5 keyword search across every transcript ever, results show
  matching lines with timestamps and link into the full transcript.
- Topic tracker: topics.json holds keywords (competitor names, pricing, churn);
  a page lists every call where each topic came up, newest first.
- Export any call to Markdown in ~/Calls/notes/YYYY-MM-DD-<name>.md.
- No accounts, no telemetry; audio stays local unless I opt into a hosted API.
- Out of scope: a bot that joins Zoom/Meet/Teams, calendar routing, CRM sync,
  and team sharing. I supply the recordings myself.
- README: dependencies, optional keys, and how to record call audio on my OS.
